blocks.text: Setting up your Mac for Google Sheets

Most financial controllers use a browser for their work. Google Chrome is the most stable choice for Sheets on macOS. You can make it feel like a native app. Open your sheet in Chrome. Click the three-dot menu in the top right corner. Select Cast, Save, and Share. Click Install page as app. Now you have a standalone icon in your Dock. This stops you from losing your finance tabs among dozens of other browser windows.

Speed matters during the month-end close. You should rarely touch your trackpad. Press ⌘ + / to open the search menu for tools. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H for find and replace. Use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9 to hide rows you do not need for your current view. Use ⌘ + ⌥ + 0 to hide columns. These shortcuts save minutes every hour. They add up to hours saved each week.

You can now handle 20 million cells in one sheet. This is a big jump from the old limits. However, huge sheets get slow. Keep your data in separate tabs. Use the IMPORTRANGE function to pull data between sheets. This keeps your main model light and fast. If you run into errors, check your punctuation. A missing comma or a broken range is the most common cause of a formula error.

Finance work involves a high coordination tax. You spend time chasing department heads for data. Use shared sheets with strict permissions. Set up protected ranges so others cannot break your formulas. Use the comment feature to track who needs to provide input. This reduces the need for long email chains. It keeps all the context in one place.

blocks.text: How to use Lazur to work faster

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It helps you stay focused on your spreadsheet. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a formula you forgot. Ask where a specific menu item is. Lazur will draw a circle around it for you. This is better than digging through menus. If you need to draft a quick email to a department head, hold fn and dictate your message. It will appear right at your cursor.

Manual data entry is a major drain on your time. Use the import features to pull data from CSV files directly. Clean your data once with a template. Use a consistent structure for your columns. This allows you to reuse your formulas month after month. You can also use Pivot Tables to summarize large datasets in seconds. They are the best way to view variances against your budget.

faq.question: Is there a native Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, there is no official native app. You can create a Progressive Web App (PWA) shortcut via Chrome to get a similar experience.

faq.question: How do I see all keyboard shortcuts in Sheets?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / to open the built-in shortcut helper window.

faq.question: What is the cell limit for a Google Sheet?
faq.answer: As of September 2026, the limit is 20 million cells per spreadsheet.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can use it to ask questions about functions or to dictate text into cells.
